steps: Stellaroids surge forth in an overwhelming wave that even Firefly cannot withstand. To protect her, people fall one by one... At the final moment, Firefly's weapon begins to glow.
Took days, but I finally caught their trail.==W== Is the Eye of Grace actually about to make a move?
No hard proof, but they've petitioned the board. They're already mobilizing in the shadows, not even waiting for approval.
If they drag Firefly back to the lab, they'll resort to extreme measures. They won't stop until they bleed her dry.
Firefly is a rare success. She's the perfect candidate to wield Avalanche.
Shatter her mind, and Avalanche becomes scrap metal. A fact that those fools still fail to grasp.
But enough complaining.==W== My point is, my hands are tied. If they weaponize Eye of Grace protocols against me, I can't intervene in time.
That's why I need outsiders like you and that Tyrant to step in.
... Understood. What do you need me to do?
Keep Firefly away from the Monolith.==W== I've seen tech that can warp the environment inside.==W== If they deploy it, the tower becomes a death trap.
Other than that, don't panic. Stick to your normal routine until this blows over.
... We have a problem. I already left Firefly in Tyrant's care. I even cleared them to enter the Monolith.
Sorry, I need to head back. I have a terrible feeling about this...
... Of course. My hunches are never wrong.
This Stellaroid surge... Someone is behind it.
Are you dealing with a swarm too?
Yes, it is a nightmare out there.==W== Long story short, we need to leave. Now.
... It's not just the Stellaroids. The Monolith itself is changing.
This is the exact same floor! Why are we back here?
You're still here? I figure you're safely outside by now.
We are trying to leave... But we keep ending up back here. It makes no sense.
This is like a Stella Drama I've seen recently!==W== Do we have to find a specific Exit No. X or something?
But the real showstopper is this Stellaroid parade.
Seeing this many in one place is a total spectacle.==W== Don't tell me we have to fight through all of them.
Just the thought makes me dizzy.
How do we even break through this?
No, Firefly! There're too many! You won't last!
What do you mean she won't last?
... Her weapon, Avalanche. Its power comes at a massive cost. It will take a severe toll on her body.==W== She's too young to keep this up for long.
Then we back her up. We do whatever we can to help.
These Stellaroids on me...==W== They're so heavy...==W==
There're too many for you to fight alone. We need to stick together and break through.
Why...? Don't you believe in me?==W== I can do it. I'll keep everyone safe...
We do believe in you. Everyone here is counting on you—because you matter to us.
You do. Don't forget, you're one of us now. You're fighting to protect everyone—so let us protect you, too.
As the battle wears on, Firefly unleashes force with a ferocity none has seen before.
The group carves through wave after wave of enemies, shattering the Stellaroid encirclement and pushing toward the exit.
She's pale as a ghost...==W== Canace was right to worry.
Using it that many times in a row... The mental toll is unimaginable.
The Stellaroids are regrouping! We're gonna get surrounded again!
So I am actually ... that tired...
Forget it. Pull the plug on today's run.
The telemetry is all over the place. We can run the numbers back at the lab, but don't hold your breath.
Oh, give it a rest. If asking the subject actually worked, they wouldn't need to pay us.
Every day... It hurts... And I felt so sad...
Honestly... I hated it... I hated all of it...
Listen to me, Firefly. You don't need to force a smile. Every day in that place was nothing but pain. If anything...==W== You have every right to cry.
Cry...?==W== But ... the tears won't come.
Did I do something wrong? Am I ... weird?
No, of course not. You have feelings like everyone else... Like any other kid.
You simply haven't found them yet. You locked your feelings away to protect yourself.==W== But one day, that lock will break open...
When it hurts... When it's unbearable... I want to cry.
You're not laying a finger on Firefly!
Heh, perfect timing. Didn't think we'd return the favor this fast.
Grandpa always said you can run from a debt, but you pay back a favor while you're still breathing!
Haha, you are right... We must keep little Firefly safe.
Hey, stay with me!==W== No, we're overrun... I have to at least get Firefly out—
... Everyone's going down ... because of me...
Why...? Don't you believe in me?==W== I can do it. I'll keep everyone safe...
We do believe in you. Everyone here is counting on you—because you matter to us.
You do. Don't forget, you're one of us now. You're fighting to protect everyone—so let us protect you, too.
I won't forgive anyone who hurts professor.
So ... listen to me. Wake up.
Fight with me... We have to protect the people who "matter"!==B====W== This time, it's no playing games.
